claim_boundaries.constructed_reference_only: The inherited constructed pure-reflection correspondent remains a deterministic reference, not recovered fixture truth, an observed image, a counterfactual rollout or an independent measurement.
claim_boundaries.coordinate_description_only: The reported operands and approximate extrema describe the frozen stored coordinate representation. No physical, camera, frame or representation invariance or ranking is claimed.
claim_boundaries.exactness_domain: Exact means equality over rational interpretations of the pinned finite binary floating-point coordinates. It does not authenticate source precision, physical truth, uncertainty or measurement accuracy.
claim_boundaries.no_degeneracy_or_angle_claim: No threshold is used and no row is classified for collinearity, degeneracy, angle, similarity, conditioning, quality or acceptance.
claim_boundaries.not_primary_endpoint: Rows have no request-start, generated-horizon or executed-time correspondence. They are not r0,rhat,r and answer neither A7 nor any A1-A9 question.
claim_boundaries.residual_space_not_physical_geometry: Gram determinants and exterior-product squares are residual-vector-space algebra. They are not physical scene areas, plane normals, object orientations, image footprints, masks, silhouettes or visible areas.
claim_boundaries.science_and_release: No threshold, fitting, registration, normalization, rank, forecast metric, current-state inference, qualification, gate advance, dispatch authority or confirmation release follows.
claim_boundaries.selection_and_confounding: The three mapping pairs remain availability-selected. D01/D02 are command-confounded and P00 has unequal command membership. No layout, command, model, task-success, population or camera effect is estimated.

construction_semantics.fixed_order: A=banana,B=bowl,C=rubiks_cube; eAB=A-B and eAC=A-C. No operand, object, coordinate or camera reordering is performed.
construction_semantics.projected_identity: For frozen eAB and eAC in two stored image-plane coordinates, the exact identity ||eAB||^2||eAC||^2-(eAB dot eAC)^2=det(eAB,eAC)^2 is verified over rational arithmetic.
construction_semantics.stored_coordinate_domain: Each finite JSON edge coordinate is interpreted as its exact binary floating-point rational value. Integer numerator/denominator strings make the identity checks tolerance-free and independently reproducible.
construction_semantics.units_and_approximations: World Gram determinants are in m^4 with descriptive mm^4 copies; projected Gram determinants are in px^4. Approximate JSON numbers are display aids only; exact numerator/denominator strings control equality. No normalization or tolerance is applied.
construction_semantics.world_identity: For frozen eAB and eAC in three stored coordinates, the exact identity ||eAB||^2||eAC||^2-(eAB dot eAC)^2=||eAB cross eAC||^2 is verified over rational arithmetic.

finding: All 9 world and 36 projected retained residual-triangle rows satisfy their exact rational Gram identities, with 279 serialized exact scalar records and zero identity residual in every row. This is a deterministic stored-coordinate consistency result only, not evidence about physical area, orientation, collinearity, visibility, motion, forecast skill, effects or any scientific gate.
